docs(guidance): leave squashing to the skill

## Intent

The skill lernapps-commit already says to squash and how to write the message. The plan templates should not repeat it, so the rule lives in one place.

## Key changes

- The increment template merges the pull request into main without naming squash or the skill.
- The first-version template only swaps the fast-forward for a squash, since the merge command differs.
